name: Mauritzon Tan Water Resistant Canvas Tarp - 8' x 10' - CTW-15-01-08...
description: When you think of tarps the traditional canvas tarp generally comes to mind. All Mauritzon canvas tarps are made with 100% cotton. Made in the USA, canvas tarps are cut, stitched, hemmed and sewn at the time of order. You can choose olive drab, brown, green, tan, white, or blue in a multitude of sizes. The finished size includes grommets in 24" standard spacing. While they are treated with a petroleum based wax water repellant they are not water-proof. If allowed to sit in the elements during heavy rains, water will seep through. They are tear and mildews resistant. The cotton duct fabric has double-stitched seams and hems.
